$2 MILLION VAULT's prizes make it a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $2,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

The numbers for "$2 MILLION VAULT" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
992.headline: How prizes are split

993.body:
The top prize count on "$5,000 Triple Play" has not moved for four months. The game still has three of six top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "$5,000 Triple Play" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
993.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

994.body:
"$25,000 Triple Play" has 111,745 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $3,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The table below shows the full count for "$25,000 Triple Play", with every prize level included.
994.headline: What's actually left to win

995.body:
"$200,000 Triple Play" has two of four top prizes left and is well into its run. About two-thirds of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

The numbers for "$200,000 Triple Play" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
995.headline: Where this game is in its run

996.body:
"$1,000,000 Triple Play" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $1,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Tomorrow's count on "$1,000,000 Triple Play" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
